info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Rail Operations Status API
info.description: The Payment Rail Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the status of banking payment operations. It enables users to track the progress and current state of payments being processed through various payment rails. This API is valuable for financial institutions, payment processors, and developers integrating payment solutions, allowing them to monitor transactions effectively. It ensures timely updates and enhances operational transparency for businesses managing payment workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of payment rail operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of the payment rail operations, providing insights into their functionality and any issues that may arise.
